title: Certify all nearest Clifford chart steps on the round-three word (no new κ)
body:
The common-axis contact search leaves independent Clifford chart changes untested. This adds a complete source-bound census of all nearest charts at every unfrozen contact and at every group constrained to preserve original zero edges on Cao Yifan’s PR4610 round-three word.

All **19,458,880** moves have nonnegative paid-minus-productive energy for every saving **0 <= C <= .005**. Exact signed rank histograms, independent Python witness invoices, discrete concave dominance and outward 128-bit integer intervals establish the result. All formerly free edges, changed native warps, eight owned centers and 408 distinct arbitrary helpers are included. The selected κ remains **0.00302015**. This is a finite local obstruction, not a global optimum or a new supplier.

The registered replay recompiles and reruns both complete censuses, checks all 153 tiny Lagrangians, 5,661 literal independent-axis pairs, 1,143 sequential compositions, three corruption controls and a positive descent fixture. It also replays final rank invoices for 1,960 exploratory plateau moves; those walks found no improvement and are not exhaustive.

Validation: registered replay and isolated optimized-Python replay pass; exact committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass; a read-only Git-free isolated replay reproduces the full certificate. Hosted [run 39935262575](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39935262575) failed in the shared onboarding fixture suite before this package replay (eight inherited failures; replay skipped). Existing [PR #5123](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5123), head `95f875490c9d8d198ac594991962c4b2ebc8e017`, addresses those exact fixture failures. No hosted package pass is claimed. The branch is based on refreshed canonical main `20a1e31bc6009b9b3f4d084bbaadc6350e34fcba`, with source inputs pinned to the original assignment base. No selected record or frozen predecessor file changes.

Proof, exact scope, reproduction commands and open next questions are in `research/independent-clifford-expansion/`. Joint multi-group replacements, changed scalar contacts and new native/owned protocols remain open; continued higher-κ work will change those premises.

Credit Cao Yifan/PR4610, Dugongue/PR4654, the prior general Gaussian contact and phase-rank-debt packages, Cinna Davis’s PR4470/controller lineage, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained source contributors. Prepared for Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
